research_insight_text_link.research_insight_description: Coral Genomics is focused on developing methods for analyzing cells to enhance clinical test procedures. Their approach aims to streamline the prior authorization process and optimize medication selection. This innovation could potentially refine the precision of clinical diagnostics and treatment efficacy.

overview_description.description: Coral develops new clinical tests to help providers streamline prior authorization and select the effective medication for a particular patient focusing on autoimmune conditions such as Inflammatory Bowel Disease and Rheumatoid Arthritis. It has also identified a unique population of non-responder patients and is working with drug developers to address this unmet medical need.
